titleAr: طلب قالب خدمة على الرقم المشترك
titleEn: Request a service template on the shared number

undo.note: the request goes to the platform team; it can be left unanswered but not withdrawn

ar: عايز قالب خدمة على الرقم المشترك
ازاي اطلب قالب جديد من الفريق؟
قالب كود التحقق على الرقم المشترك
en: How do I ask the team for a template on the shared number?

steps: Request a service template: name, language, type (service or verification code), the text you need; the team creates it and the request closes by itself
edgeCases: At most 5 open requests per store (429 too_many_open_requests)
Staff may list requests, only the owner may send one
assistantNote: sends a request to the Ebda team; confirm first
